name: lakeside-dental-agent
description: AI booking agent for Lakeside Dental — Node/TS backend (OpenAI + Groq failover) and a premium React chat UI.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
